tools.name: read_invoices
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches 1 to 20 invoice PDFs and wants them in a spreadsheet, wants invoice data extracted (vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, subtotal, tax or VAT or GST, shipping, discount, total, amount due, line items), or wants the invoice arithmetic checked. Returns one Ex

tools.name: check_invoice_math
tools.description: Use this when the user types or pastes invoice amounts (line quantities, unit prices, line amounts, subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, total) and wants to know whether the invoice adds up. Returns PASS, MISMATCH with the difference in cents, or NOT CHECKABLE when a value is missing, for three checks
